modiphius-warehouse-clearance-dune-adven.verdict: Recommends it even to non-fans; the shared Great House and House-versus-House intrigue is a risk that pays off.
Excellent game of narrative intrigue and action for fans of the books and films; misses random events for dynastic play.

bundle-of-holding-monster-hunters-of-the.verdict: Top recommendation of the new hardback; a go-to game for learning PbtA and onboarding new players.
Loves it as a showcase of Powered by the Apocalypse design; great for one-shot mysteries and introducing newcomers.

amazon-us-dungeons-dragons-worlds-realms.verdict: A fun romp through beloved settings for veteran gamers and DMs; weaker on Mystara and Eberron.
Strong, engaging lore tour and handy prep tool that every Dungeon Master should own.
Recommended as a coffee-table book with great art; dislikes the Mordenkainen narration and it's not a game volume.

itch-io-blackwellwriter-apothecaria.verdict: A genuinely lovely cosy solo game, though the layout splits and misplaces rules explanations.
Favourable: a relaxing writing game that could help with writer's block.
Superb, relaxing and cosy; balances structured rules with creative freedom and may help aspiring writers.

itch-io-rori-montford-dead-letter-societ.verdict: Strongly positive: thorough world creation, excellent atmosphere, lovely art and layout, plus a solo variant.
Enthusiastic: a dream for vampire pen-pals, free choice of vampire and world, intuitive system, beautiful book.

itch-io-blackwellwriter-for-small-creatu.verdict: Accessible sci-fi game with sci-fi influences; a must-play, especially for Star Wars RPG fans.

paizo-store-pathfinder-rpg-core-rulebook.verdict: Same content as the big book, cheaper and easier to carry; deep customization, but complex and it wears with use.
Loves Pathfinder; the pocket edition trades some readability and lay-flat use for portability and a lower price.

barnes-noble-lord-of-the-rings-rpg-start.verdict: A confident, accessible entry to Tolkien roleplaying; best for D&D veterans and Tolkien fans, newcomers may need guidance.
Calls it a great way to jump into the Lord of the Rings roleplaying world.

evil-hat-webstore-thirsty-sword-lesbians.verdict: Well designed and mostly fun with praised safety tools, but some moves and the Strings mechanic frustrated his group.
Calls it a great addition to current Powered by the Apocalypse games and plans to run it at cons.

modiphius-warehouse-clearance-odyssey-of.source: What Do I Know About Reviews?
modiphius-warehouse-clearance-odyssey-of.verdict: Qualified recommendation: a beautiful book with many strengths, but know what you are getting before buying.

drivethrurpg-vampire-the-masquerade-5th-.verdict: A pretty good edition with renewed horror focus; dislikes dropped original clans and heavy in-universe fiction.

paizo-store-pathfinder-roleplaying-game-.verdict: Calls it a solid setting sourcebook with long shelf life, useful for both First and Second Edition players.

demiplane-vampire-the-masquerade-5th-edi.verdict: Likes the linked navigation for fast rules lookups, wants a hyperlinked glossary, sees online rules sites as the industry's future.
Pretty good edition with renewed horror focus; wishes it kept all original Clans and used less in-universe fiction.

bundle-of-holding-cthulhu-awakens.verdict: Calls it a Cthulhu game breaking new ground, but wants summary charts for the dense rules and finds the sample adventures uneven.

paizo-store-pathfinder-campaign-setting-.verdict: Calls it the most complete fantasy setting he has seen and recommends it to veterans and newcomers alike.

itch-io-loot-the-room-treasures-of-the-t.verdict: Ran it over three online sessions; dark, weird, easy to run, art and layout match the core book.

bundle-of-holding-knock-magazine-bundle.verdict: Calls issue #1 a strong, dense OSR collection and a treasure trove for GMs; minor typos and glossy finish.

itch-io-boocherry-enter-the-survival-hor.verdict: Likes how it adapts Blades in the Dark mechanics to survival horror, especially the find-what-you-need loot idea.
